channel.title: MateAI
channel.description:
AI, measured. Short videos on how much we use AI, how much we've come to depend on it, and what it really costs.

We use AI every day, and there are good reasons to stay skeptical about where it's heading. So this channel tests it and keeps the numbers: the same task run ten times, a week without it, what breaks when it goes down, what our usage costs at list price. Failures stay in.

No get-rich promises, no "AI will replace you" hype, no stack of paid tools. Most tests stay inside one provider, and the channel says when that changes.

The voice you hear is my clone, made with AI. If something is AI-made, you'll be told.
